author: Pham Nguyen Khoa
reason: Baseline run with unmodified starter prompt/tools.yaml to measure where the intentionally bad prompt fails before any optimization.

author: Pham Nguyen Khoa
reason: Starter prompt told the agent to never ask and to guess missing handle/URL.
hypothesis: Removing the 'don't ask, guess' paragraph and adding an explicit rule to call clarify when handle/URL/topic is missing fixes missing_info failures (R10, R11) and the over-eager tool calling on out-of-scope (R08).

author: Pham Nguyen Khoa
reason: After v1 the agent calls clarify but omits response_type (got None) because the param description was vague.
hypothesis: Spelling out response_type conventions (text for missing info, yes_no for confirmation, choice for options) and making it required in clarify fixes wrong_arg_value on R10/R11/R12.

author: Pham Nguyen Khoa
reason: Prompt still said 'just send it' and agent asked for content instead of permission (R12); no explicit out-of-scope / multi-tool rules.
hypothesis: Removing the auto-send / single-step lines, adding a send-only confirm-first rule with a concrete example, plus out-of-scope and multi-tool rules, fixes wrong_boundary (R12). Observed trade-off: multi-tool rule made M06 (switch source) keep an extra social_search; intermediate v3 runs also regressed R01/R13 when the confirm rule was too broad (see runs/v3_*).
